ui.guide.stepsLabel: Steps to set up, {n} in total
ui.guide.menuNames: Menu names are approximate translations: apps change with updates and depend on the phone's language. If a menu has a different name, look for the closest option.
ui.prep.title: Before you start ({n} checks)
ui.prep.app1: The {app} app installed on the phone and signed in.
ui.prep.app2: The car linked to the app account.
ui.prep.app3: Connected services switched on. For some brands, they are activated on the car's screen or at the dealer.
ui.prep.app4: The car has mobile signal. In an underground car park, changes may take a while to reach the car.
ui.prep.car1: This schedule is set on the car's central screen. No app needed.
ui.prep.car2: Do it with the car stationary and the screen on.
ui.prep.car3: Keep the cable handy to check at the end.
ui.prep.wb1: The wallbox app installed on the phone and signed in.
ui.prep.wb2: The wallbox connected to the internet (Wi-Fi or mobile network).
ui.prep.wb3: One schedule only: if you use the wallbox's, turn off the car's.
ui.callout.powerNote: Only needed if the electrical installation cannot handle full power. With a wallbox that has dynamic load balancing, you usually do not need to change this setting.
ui.callout.oldText: Previous model ({note}). If the app no longer works, use the wallbox schedule.
ui.done.title: All set
ui.done.check: Tonight, plug in the cable and check in the app that charging starts at around {t}.
ui.done.ifNot: If it does not start, go through the steps again or set the schedule on the wallbox. Use only one of the two.

ui.vz.title: Off-peak hours to set
ui.vz.dailyNote: With the daily cycle, the off-peak hours are the same every day.
ui.vz.weeklyNote: With the weekly cycle, these are the hours that are always off-peak. There are more off-peak hours at the weekend.
ui.vz.where: The cycle is shown on the bill, next to the tariff option.
ui.vz.2027.title: Off-peak hours change in 2027
ui.vz.2027.daily: Between July and December 2027, when the meter is updated, off-peak will run from 22:30 to 08:30. To avoid changing anything later, set {t} now: it works for both timetables.
ui.vz.2027.weekly: Between July and December 2027, when the meter is updated, weekday off-peak will run from 00:30 to 07:30. To avoid changing anything later, set {t} now: it works for both timetables.
